meta.title: Bishrelt Hotel — A New Standard of Luxury
meta.description: Genuine Ulaanbaatar luxury since 1994. Bishrelt Hotel — Ulaanbaatar's premier luxury hotel.

hero.description: Luxurious surroundings, world-class service, and an unforgettable escape — Bishrelt Hotel awaits you in a serene and perfect sanctuary.

gallery.description: From the moment you arrive, you will be captivated by the harmony of surroundings, the luxury of materials, and the extraordinary quality of craftsmanship in every detail.

items.name: Deluxe King Room
items.description: The Deluxe King Room perfectly blends comfort and modern design — the ideal choice for travelers and business guests. Soft lighting, a minimalist luxurious interior, and a king-size bed with premium bedding ensure deep rest.

items.name: Junior Suite
items.description: The Junior Suite features a separate living room and bedroom in a lavish setting. Enjoy sweeping panoramic city views. The generous space offers complete peace and tranquil rest.

items.name: Executive Suite
items.description: The Executive Suite is a luxury suite designed for business guests, featuring a private meeting room and personal chef service. Floor-to-ceiling panoramic windows and state-of-the-art equipment throughout.

items.name: Presidential Suite
items.description: Our most prestigious Presidential Suite is designed for chief executives. Featuring a private meeting room, personal chef service, and the pinnacle of luxury on the city's highest floor.

restaurant.heading: Embassy Restaurant
restaurant.description: Experience extraordinary flavors at our exclusive luxury restaurant. Award-winning chefs use only the finest seasonal ingredients, blending Mongolian heritage with modern cuisine for an exquisite dining experience.

features.title: Michelin-Inspired Cuisine
features.desc: Innovative dishes crafted with modern culinary techniques

features.title: Wine Cellar
features.desc: A curated collection of 300+ wines from the world's finest regions

features.title: Private Dining Rooms
features.desc: Exclusive rooms for business meetings and private events

events.heading: Grand Event Halls
events.description: A perfect setting for weddings, conferences, and every special occasion. Modern equipment, spacious interiors, and professional service — making every moment unforgettable.

karaoke.heading: Karaoke & Lounge
karaoke.description1: Karaoke & Lounge combines music, relaxation, and entertainment all in one modern, comfortable space. Perfect for friends, colleagues, or simply unwinding in style.
karaoke.description2: Private karaoke rooms with quality sound systems and a comfortable lounge area give you different vibes all in one place. Create an unforgettable evening with drinks and light bites.

quotes.text: The room was spotless, the bed incredibly comfortable, and the staff were so friendly. Breakfast was delightful — a truly relaxing place I'd happily return to.
quotes.author: B. Bat-Yeröölt

quotes.text: The service at Bishrelt Hotel was truly outstanding. The room's elegance, the chefs' extraordinary cuisine, and the warm hospitality of the staff were all simply perfect.
quotes.author: D. Oyuunbaatar

quotes.text: The conference hall was beautifully equipped — full technical setup and staff who assisted with true professional expertise. We will definitely return.
quotes.author: G. Bold-Erdene

quotes.text: Karaoke & Lounge has become my favorite place to unwind. An enormous song library, incredibly comfortable VIP rooms, and prompt, attentive service.
quotes.author: N. Sarantuya

quotes.text: The food at Embassy Restaurant was delicious with a beautiful presentation. The ambiance, lighting, and overall setting all came together to create a truly luxurious atmosphere.
quotes.author: E. Munkhbat

footer.description: Where Mongolian heritage meets world-class luxury. An unforgettable experience awaits at every visit.

roomDetail.bookingNote: All rates include breakfast for two guests
